author: Karl Rock
description:
People in Pakistan keep randomly speaking Pashto to me before switching to Urdu or English when I look confused! 😅

I've been told it's because I look like a Pathan (Pashtun), especially when I'm wearing a shalwar kameez. It's funny how the way you look or dress can completely change how locals interact with you.

Do you think I could pass as a Pathan? Let me know in the comments!
title: Why Do They Speak Pashto to Me?
